company.description: Company board identifier supplied in input.

id.description: Source job identifier. Combined with source and company for deduplication.

location.description: Published location text, including available secondary locations.

remote.description: Remote status from structured fields or location text; null when unknown.

publishedAt.description: Available publication or source creation date normalized to ISO UTC.

updatedAt.description: Source update date normalized to ISO UTC, when available.

salaryMin.description: Structured minimum salary without currency conversion.

salaryMax.description: Structured maximum salary without currency conversion.

salaryPeriod.description: Recognized salary period: hour, day, week, month or year.
